name: The way home
source:
The way home is a short horror visual novel where you play as a young girl. The aim of the game is to get home but that isn't as easy as it seems.

[from [url=https://samiishii.itch.io/the-way-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《回家的路》是一部简短的恐怖视觉小说，你在其中扮演一个年轻女孩。游戏的目标是回家，但这并不像看起来那么容易。

[来自[url=https://samiishii.itch.io/the-way-home]itch.io[/url]]
